narr: A northward surge in tropical moisture will resulted widespread showers and thunderstorms across northern Arizona. Heavy rain over far northcentral Arizona and south central Utah resulted in a flash flood. A strong rotating thunderstorms also developed over far eastern Arizona.
ev: Heavy rain over far south-central Utah and far north-central Arizona resulted in a flash flood through Paria Canyon. The river gauge near the Colorado River showed almost a 4 foot rise.
lsr: THE RIVER GAUGE ON THE PARIA RIVER AT LEES FERRY REPORTED ALMOST A 4 FOOT RISE (4.15 TO 8.01 FEET) FROM 800 PM TO 815 PM MST. THIS WAS DUE TO HEAVY RAIN IN UTAH.
